summary: Lucky Forge is an RPG tower defense game where luck and strategy defend castle
description:
Welcome to Lucky Forge: Idle TD Game — a luck and strategy RPG where your skills and luck shape the fate of your castle! In this tower defense game, you don't build towers or armies — you forge mighty swords by luck, merge powerful weapons, and survive relentless waves of enemies attacking your tower. Will your luck hold? Can your strategy and skills defend your kingdom?

Luck is the heart of Lucky Forge. Every sword you forge is a roll of fate, and your luck decides whether you craft legendary weapons or common blades. Merge swords, unlock new powerful weapons, and sharpen your skills. This isn't just an idle game — it's a dynamic tower defense game where every decision counts. Protect your castle with weapons forged from pure luck and strategic merging.

Defend your tower from overwhelming enemy armies and fearsome bosses. As waves of enemies assault your defenses, your forged weapons stand between destruction and survival. Merge and upgrade swords to strengthen your arsenal. With each successful merge, your defense grows stronger and your odds improve.

Explore special events and challenging dungeons to unlock rare rewards and epic weapons. Lucky Forge offers more than survival — dive into limited-time events where luck can earn you exclusive swords and heroes. Take on dungeons full of fierce enemies and bosses to test your skills and strategy. This is a tower defense game with deep RPG elements to keep you engaged for hours.

What makes Lucky Forge special:

- Forge swords by luck and merge them into ultimate weapons for defense.

- Defend your castle from waves of enemies and powerful bosses.

- Engage in exciting events and challenging dungeons to win rare rewards.

- Use strategy and skills to manage your weapon upgrades and survive the war.

- Combine satisfying idle progression with tactical tower defense gameplay.

- Test your luck and strategy in a truly unique RPG environment.

- Progress offline and keep forging weapons even when you're away.

In Lucky Forge, luck isn't just a chance — it's your most powerful weapon. Merge swords, refine your strategy, and develop your skills to outlast enemy onslaughts. Your castle depends on your luck and decision-making to survive and triumph in this epic war. Are you ready to become the master of the forge and defend your kingdom?

Forge legendary weapons, defend your castle, and survive the toughest tower defense challenges in Lucky Forge: Idle TD Game.
